claims.evidence: PRIDE: "selected phosphopeptides were synthesized as heavy isotope labeled counterparts and spiked into enriched phosphoproteome samples". One column per synthetic standard (SAMPLE-GUIDELINES "Spiked-in Samples"): the distinct (Peptide Sequence, Protein Name) pairs carrying "medium" (Skyline internal_standard) rows in A549_2h_Phosphoproteome_Targeted_Quant.txt = 28 standards over 27 sequences (TP53BP1 SGTAETEPVEQDSSQPSLPLVR exists as pS830 and pS831 positional isomers, two distinct medium precursors in the .sky). CN = protein + phosphosite from the Protein Name column (review round 2 finding 3). limitations: Paper full text (PMC5417826, CC-BY hybrid) not retrievable: Europe PMC fullTextXML HTTP 500, Unpaywall/Europe PMC PDF HTTP 403, PMC HTML/PDF behind reCAPTCHA, NCBI efetch returned front matter only, BioC/PMC-OA S3 had no copy. Methods taken from PRIDE protocol text + deposited search/Skyline outputs; abstract only from the paper.

Light=sham / heavy=irradiated is stated only in the PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol; it was cross-validated for the 9 phospho replicates from deposited Phospho (STY)Sites.txt (pS/TQ sites up in H/L in every replicate). Proteome replicates could not be independently checked (protein-level changes negligible per abstract); same lysates per PRIDE protocol.

Per-search modification sets: the SDRF was built per sub-experiment (sdrf-tools build x3 with identical headers; not applicable where a search lacked a mod) and concatenated by scripts/split_build.py after asserting identical headers and full file coverage. The concatenation step is outside sdrf-tools build. Missed cleavages (2 proteome vs 4 phospho) not encoded.

Targeted spike-in runs (rows 523-538) were not database-searched in the deposit; their modification parameters come from the deposited Skyline document (incl. the synthetic-standard labels UNIMOD:695/268/269). Spike amount unknown (QY=not available in each of the 27 spiked-compound columns); phosphosite/label of each standard not expressible in PS=.

characteristics[individual], [passage number], [culture medium], [sample storage temperature] = not available: no accessible source (PRIDE protocol, abstract) states them; the SILAC medium base is unstated.

characteristics[mass] (injected mass, SAMPLE-GUIDELINES) not added: the column is not licensed by ms-proteomics 1.2.0 / human 1.1.0 / cell-lines 1.1.0 (absent from TERMS.tsv and the contract); the injected amount is unstated anyway (150 ug is pre-enrichment input).

parse_sdrf convert-openms (quantms) fails on rows 523-538 because both tolerance columns are not applicable (it also fails with not available); validate-sdrf accepts it. A quantms reprocessing would need those runs dropped or given explicit tolerances.

Dose confound: modality and dose co-vary (6 Gy X-ray, 3.5 Gy proton, 2 Gy carbon ion; doses chosen as biologically equivalent per PRIDE), so factor value[treatment] encodes modality+dose jointly; dose has no licensed column (clinical-metadata dose units exclude Gy).
Targeted run 160315_MW2585_P2-1.RAW is referenced by the deposited Skyline document but was not deposited; only 8 targeted runs annotated (proton heavy arm has 89 files vs 90).

Proteome/phospho/targeted samples of the same arm+replicate are assumed to derive from the same SILAC-mixed lysate (PRIDE: same lysates for 15 ug proteome and 150 ug phospho; targeted replicate names match). Encoded as separate source names with a shared biological replicate index.
Doses (6 Gy X-ray, 3.5 Gy proton, 2 Gy carbon ion) and irradiation facility not encoded: no licensed dose column in ms-proteomics/human/cell-lines.

Reduction/alkylation reagents not stated in any accessible source (Carbamidomethyl fixed in search) -> not available. Phospho 2-fraction method (IMAC/TiO2 combination) has no PRIDE:0000550 child -> comment[fractionation method] not available on rows 487-522.
characteristics[cell type] epithelial cell comes only from the PRIDE organismParts submitter field.

Treatment terms are NCIT radiotherapy-modality terms (X-ray Therapy, Proton Beam Radiation Therapy, Carbon Ion Radiotherapy) applied to in-vitro irradiation; NCIT:C40431 Proton Radiation rejected (defined as radioactive decay).
techsdrf not installed: instrument/acquisition verified by HTTP range-read of 3 raw headers (one per sub-experiment), not every file.
